title: Cardinals rookie OL Chase Bisontis reportedly suffered torn MCL, will undergo surgery next week

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cardinals rookie OL Chase Bisontis reportedly suffered torn MCL, will undergo surgery next week
sources.description: Bisontis was carted off the field in Thursday's preseason game, and is now likely to miss all, or at least most, of the 2026 season.
